title: Introducing a walking tour
passage: M1: Welcome to the Old Port architecture walk. A television crew is at the customs house, so we'll start across the square at the old grain exchange. That's now an art gallery. We'll see its preserved trading hall before visiting the customs house on our way back. You may take photos in the hall, but no flash. The walk has uneven stone paths, so watch your step. The restroom is by the ticket counter. Please use it before we leave.
passageZh: 歡迎參加老港建築步行導覽。有電視團隊正在海關大樓，因此我們從廣場對面的舊穀物交易所開始。它現在是一間藝廊。我們會先看保存下來的交易大廳，回程再參觀海關大樓。大廳可以拍照，但不要用閃光燈。沿途有不平的石路，請留意腳步。洗手間在售票櫃檯旁，請在出發前使用。
